# FG-WEB-0011

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_bad_widget_setting_is_422` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ウィジェットの設定の値が正しくありません。設定を開き直して選び直してください。
- en: A widget setting has an invalid value. Open the settings and choose again.
- id: Nilai pengaturan widget tidak valid. Buka pengaturan dan pilih lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

A portal widget route (ADR-0036, PFS portal contract v1 §6.1) got a query value it does not accept: `kind` other than review / mine / stopped / spec, `scope` other than mine / reviews, `show` other than pipeline / deploy, `limit` outside 3..=10, `project` that is not a positive id (or more than 24 of them), `locale` other than ja / en / id, `tz` that is not an IANA zone name, a single-valued key repeated, or a query that is not valid percent-encoding. Unknown keys are ignored (the contract). Nothing was read.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `param` and `rule` (`unknown_value`, `out_of_range`, `not_positive_decimal`, `repeated`, `too_many`, `invalid`). Compare with the widget declaration (`docs/portal/widgets.md`).

## 対処 (fix)

The portal's settings form sends only the declared values; a 422 means the declaration and the portal's copy differ, or a hand-made request. Align the declaration (iotpf-portal catalog) with docs/portal/widgets.md.
